name: Emilia-Romagna

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A regional DOC covering Emilia-Romagna. Trebbiano Romagnolo is the most planted grape at 30% of vineyard area, followed by Sangiovese at 13% and Lambrusco Salamino at 10%. Inside it sit Romagna, Modena, Reggiano and Lambrusco appellations.
